# Isaac Capture

> Isaac Capture is shared capture infrastructure for teleoperation (Isaac Teleop) and egocentric data (Ego Pipeline): device plugins, retargeters, and data utilities for recording, replaying, and converting human and robot demonstration data.


2025-2026, NVIDIA CORPORATION & AFFILIATES, last updated on November 10, 2026
